nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances; token balance ledger of MetaMask_Swap_Token
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowed; allowance ledger
uint256 _totalSupply = 90700000000000000000000; total supply, decremented on burn
uint256 public basePercent = 100; rounding base used in findOnePercentb
caller-controlled address used as owner/from/spender in transfer, approve, allowance, burn and mint paths
transfer(address to,uint256 value) public; debits msg.sender and credits to
transferFrom(address from,address to,uint256 value) public; moves tokens using and updating allowance
approve(address spender,uint256 value) public; sets _allowed[msg.sender][spender]
increaseAllowance(address spender,uint256 addedValue) public; adds to allowance
decreaseAllowance(address spender,uint256 subtractedValue) public; subtracts from allowance
findOnePercentb(uint256 value) public view; rounds value with basePercent then computes one percent
_mint(address account,uint256 amount) internal; credits balance and emits Transfer from address(0)
_burn(address account,uint256 amount) internal; destroys tokens and reduces _totalSupply
burn(uint256 amount) external; burns msg.sender tokens via _burn
burnFrom(address account,uint256 amount) external; reduces allowance then burns account tokens
multiTransfer(address[] receivers,uint256[] amounts) public; loops calling transfer for each receiver
constructor() public payable; sets ERC20Detailed metadata and mints _totalSupply to msg.sender
uint256 arithmetic: value.ceil(basePercent) then roundValue.mul(basePercent).div(10000)
uint256 arithmetic: value.sub(tokensToBurn), _balances[msg.sender].sub(value), _balances[to].add(tokensToTransfer), _totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn)
uint256 arithmetic: sub/add on _balances, _totalSupply and _allowed[from][msg.sender]
uint256 arithmetic: _totalSupply.sub(amount) and _balances[account].sub(amount)
uint256 arithmetic: _balances[account].add(amount)
uint256 arithmetic: add/sub applied to _allowed[msg.sender][spender] in increase/decreaseAllowance
